mod.overview: VXE (the entry script names it Ultra Renegades VX Extreme r0.72, by UnhOlYAngl) is VXO with retuned weapons and a per-player choice of boost and brake behavior. Each player picks VXU, VXO or VX5-style boosts and brakes from the startup menu on joining or from the Tab menu, and both are unlimited. Weapons, deployables and damage handling otherwise follow VXO.
notes: Boost/Brake Configuration (Tab menu) offers a Mod Group choice (VXU, VXO or VX5 for both) or a Custom choice that sets boosts (VXU/VXO or VX5) and brakes (VXU, VXO or VX5) separately. On first joining, the VXE Startup menu offers Start! or Boost/Brake setup!, which opens the group menu and spawns you after the choice. A player who never chooses gets the VXU behavior.

Mine.cs is where VXE defines $SpeedMax (300 for light, 220 for medium, 195 for heavy armor, against VXO's 200/120/95) and the VXU, VXO and VX5 boost and brake tables; ArmorData.cs no longer sets any of them.
Grenade and Beacon no longer use up items: the decItemCount lines are commented out (Commented for unlimited boosts/brakes).
Player::onDamage is VXO's, with no VX damage-type side effects.

Grenade.summary: An unlimited brake whose behavior depends on the brake style the player picked: a slight reversal (VXU, the default), a dead stop (VXO) or VX5's speed cut.
notes: VXU style multiplies your velocity by -0.1, reversing you at a tenth of your speed. VXO style multiplies it by 0, a full stop. VX5 style multiplies it by 1/6 for light, 1/4.4 for medium and 1/3.4 for heavy armor.
Unlike VXO the brake factor is applied directly, without the speed-ratio scaling.
Each use throws the zero-damage Boost charge forward as before. 0.2 s between uses; nothing is consumed.
Grenade.source: Mine.cs Grenade::onUse, Brake::UpdateVel, Brake::VX5::UpdateVel; game.cs processMenuselbrake/selboostbrake

Beacon.summary: An unlimited speed booster in VXU/VXO style (velocity multiplier) or VX5 style (knockback charge at your feet), as the player chooses.
notes: VXU/VXO style (the default) multiplies your velocity by BoostSpeed x VelRatio: 3.15 for light, 2.2 for medium, 1.7 for heavy, with VelRatio = (SpeedMax - |x speed|) / SpeedMax using the 300/220/195 SpeedMax values.
Unlike VXO, if that would not make your x-axis speed any larger the velocity is left unchanged (commented as a fix for boost lag), so a boost near or above SpeedMax no longer slows or reverses you.
VX5 style drops a VX5Boost charge at your feet: no damage, 20 m radius, 900 knockback (VX5's own charge had 500).
0.2 s between uses; nothing is consumed.
Beacon.source: Mine.cs Beacon::onUse, Boost::UpdateVel, Boost::VX5, VX5Boost; game.cs processMenuselboost/selboostbrake
